description: Estimate what a shopper may pay at the door for one parcel shipped between Canada and the United States: duty, tariffs and surtaxes, sales tax and carrier or postal fees, with the official rules in force today. Describe the product in plain words; a tariff code is suggested from it. Use for questions like "what will I pay on a hoodie from a US store shipped to Ontario?"

cusmaClaim.description: True only if the seller says the goods qualify for CUSMA and claims it

madeIn.description: Country where the product was made, for example CN; ask if unknown

mode.description: Postal mail (USPS, Canada Post) or a courier (UPS, FedEx, Purolator, DHL); courier if unknown

product.description: What the product is, in a few words, for example cotton hoodie

province.description: Province or territory when it goes to Canada, for example ON; leave out if unknown

tariffCode.description: The product's tariff code, only if known

value.description: What the goods in the parcel cost

name: door_cost_estimate
title: What a parcel may cost at the door
